'''Dataplot''' is a [[public domain software]] system for [[scientific visualization]] and [[statistical analysis]]. It was developed and is being maintained at the [[National Institute of Standards and Technology]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Statistical Software and the e-Handbook of Statistical Methods |url=https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/handbook/dataplot.htm |access-date=2022-07-23 |website=www.itl.nist.gov}}</ref> Dataplot's [[source code]] is available and in public domain.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Frequently Asked Questions |url=https://www.itl.nist.gov/div898/software/dataplot/faqs.htm |access-date=2022-07-23 |website=www.itl.nist.gov}}</ref>
